title: Empty Dye Vat and Cloth Preparation Corner
description: One static empty dye-vat and cloth-preparation corner from the original textile dye-workshop scene program. One complete deep dye vat with its genuinely perforated suspended basket and two lifting loops stands beside one complete open worktable carrying one whole three-wrap flat-core cloth bolt with its real end layers and grounded tail. All three old asset IDs preserve every whole mesh, original local POSITION/NORMAL payload, constant PBR material and internal hierarchy byte for byte. Only unit-scale whole-instance translations and one finite scene-only floor are new. One scene, zero new independent props. The full cloth-bolt footprint is within the real table top, the two whole stations are positively separated, and both complete floor footprints lie on the floor. The dye vat is empty: no liquid, dye, wetted cloth, heat, chemical process, basket lifting, person, operating factory, material compatibility, body fit, load or safety claim.
